color.army.05@condemned.stt_text: Artillery needs somebody else's eyes. The condemned better keep a scout alive
color.army.05@condemned.text: Artillery needs somebody else's eyes. The Condemned better keep a scout alive.

color.army.05@gangs.text: Artillery needs somebody else's eyes. The Wreckers better keep a scout alive.

color.army.05@law.text: Artillery needs somebody else's eyes. The Law better keep a scout alive.

color.army.05@syndicate.text: Artillery needs somebody else's eyes. The Syndicate better keep a scout alive.

color.army.06.speaker: color
color.army.06.stt_text: IFVs are honest work, nothing fancy. They'll chew up anything light
color.army.06.text: IFVs are honest work. Nothing fancy. They'll chew up anything light.

color.army.07@condemned.speaker: color
color.army.07@condemned.stt_text: The condemned's army turned slowly. Good if they get set, bad if they don't
color.army.07@condemned.text: The Condemned's army turns slowly. Good if they get set. Bad if they don't.

color.army.07@gangs.speaker: color
color.army.07@gangs.stt_text: The Wreckers army turned slowly. Good if they get set, bad if they don't
color.army.07@gangs.text: The Wreckers' army turns slowly. Good if they get set. Bad if they don't.

color.army.07@law.speaker: color
color.army.07@law.stt_text: The law's army turned slowly. Good if they get set, bad if they don't
color.army.07@law.text: The Law's army turns slowly. Good if they get set. Bad if they don't.

color.army.07@syndicate.speaker: color
color.army.07@syndicate.stt_text: The syndicate's army turns slowly. Good if they get set, bad if they don't
color.army.07@syndicate.text: The Syndicate's army turns slowly. Good if they get set. Bad if they don't.

color.army.08@condemned.speaker: color
color.army.08@condemned.stt_text: I've seen the condemned crews in the tunnel quiet. That's usually a good sign
color.army.08@condemned.text: I've seen the Condemned crews in the tunnel. Quiet. That's usually a good sign.

color.army.08@gangs.speaker: color
color.army.08@gangs.stt_text: I've seen the Wreckers crews in the tunnel. Quiet, that's usually a good sign
color.army.08@gangs.text: I've seen the Wreckers crews in the tunnel. Quiet. That's usually a good sign.

color.army.08@law.speaker: color
color.army.08@law.stt_text: I've seen the law crews in the tunnel. Quiet, that's usually a good sign
color.army.08@law.text: I've seen the Law crews in the tunnel. Quiet. That's usually a good sign.

color.army.08@syndicate.speaker: color
color.army.08@syndicate.stt_text: I've seen the Syndicate crews in the tunnel. Quiet. That's usually a good sign
color.army.08@syndicate.text: I've seen the Syndicate crews in the tunnel. Quiet. That's usually a good sign.

color.army.09.speaker: color
color.army.09.stt_text: Those machines have been rebuilt more times than anybody will tell you
color.army.09.text: Those machines have been rebuilt more times than anybody will tell you.

color.army.10.speaker: color
color.army.10.stt_text: That army was put together by somebody who has lost before. You can tell
color.army.10.text: That army was put together by somebody who has lost before. You can tell.

color.army.11.speaker: color
color.army.11.stt_text: Balanced list, nothing clever. I like it
color.army.11.text: Balanced list. Nothing clever. I like it.

color.army.12.speaker: color
color.army.12.stt_text: A bit of everything. That means somebody has to know how all of it works together
color.army.12.text: A bit of everything. That means somebody has to know how all of it works together.

color.army.13.speaker: color
color.army.13.stt_text: heavy build. They'll be slow off the line and hard to move once they're set
color.army.13.text: Heavy build. They'll be slow off the line and hard to move once they're set.

color.army.14.speaker: color
color.army.14.stt_text: All one type. Simple to drive. Simple to read too, if you're on the other side
color.army.14.text: All one type. Simple to drive. Simple to read, too, if you're on the other side.

color.army.15.speaker: color
color.army.15.stt_text: Lots of scouts. Somebody wants to see this fight before they're in it
color.army.15.text: Lots of scouts. Somebody wants to see this fight before they're in it.

color.army.16.speaker: color
color.army.16.stt_text: Tanks up front. That's a wall with a gun in it
color.army.16.text: Tanks up front. That's a wall with a gun in it.

color.army.17.speaker: color
color.army.17.stt_text: IFVs, autocannons all night. Anything thin is going to have a hard time
color.army.17.text: IFVs. Autocannons all night. Anything thin is going to have a hard time.

color.army.18.speaker: color
color.army.18.stt_text: Artillery heavy. They'll want this to last. Watch them keep their distance
color.army.18.text: Artillery-heavy. They'll want this to last. Watch them keep their distance.

color.army.19.speaker: color
color.army.19.stt_text: Lancers, long reach, thin skin. They need the floor to be big
color.army.19.text: Lancers. Long reach, thin skin. They need the floor to be big.

color.army.20.speaker: color
color.army.20.stt_text: Burners. They have to get close, which is exactly where nobody else wants to be
color.army.20.text: Burners. They have to get close, which is exactly where nobody else wants to be.

color.army.21.speaker: color
color.army.21.stt_text: I've driven against armies like that. You don't beat it. You wait for it to make a mistake
color.army.21.text: I've driven against armies like that. You don't beat it. You wait for it to make a mistake.

color.army.22.speaker: color
color.army.22.stt_text: The list tells you what they're afraid of. That one is afraid of being flanked
color.army.22.text: The list tells you what they're afraid of. That one is afraid of being flanked.

color.army.25.speaker: color
color.army.25.stt_text: All that armor is slow. If it gets caught out of position, it is a long way back
color.army.25.text: All that armor is slow. If it gets caught out of position, it is a long way back.

color.banter.01.speaker: color
color.banter.01.stt_text: Nothing useful. You're counting shells and checking mirrors
color.banter.01.text: Nothing useful. You're counting shells and checking mirrors.

color.banter.02.speaker: color
color.banter.02.stt_text: Less than you'd think. The good ones go quiet inside
color.banter.02.text: Less than you'd think. The good ones go quiet inside.

color.banter.04.speaker: color
color.banter.04.stt_text: Nobody thinks about them until they're gone. Then you're driving blind
color.banter.04.text: Nobody thinks about them until they're gone. Then you're driving blind.

color.banter.05.speaker: color
color.banter.05.stt_text: It's still the biggest. That's not the same thing
color.banter.05.text: It's still the biggest. That's not the same thing.

color.banter.06.speaker: color
color.banter.06.stt_text: If it's pointed the right way, yes. If it isn't, it's a very expensive wall
color.banter.06.text: If it's pointed the right way, yes. If it isn't, it's a very expensive wall.

color.banter.07.speaker: color
color.banter.07.stt_text: Everything in here can reach you from across the room. The wall is the only thing on your side
color.banter.07.text: Everything in here can reach you from across the room. The wall is the only thing on your side.

color.banter.08.speaker: color
color.banter.08.stt_text: You're a big target in a small room. Cover is the only thing that makes you small
color.banter.08.text: You're a big target in a small room. Cover is the only thing that makes you small.

color.banter.09.speaker: color
color.banter.09.stt_text: Luck and the kind of patience most people lose on the first day
color.banter.09.text: Luck. And the kind of patience most people lose on the first day.

color.banter.10.speaker: color
color.banter.10.stt_text: You win enough, and one day they stop calling your number. That's how it happened for me
color.banter.10.text: You win enough, and one day they stop calling your number. That's how it happened for me.

color.banter.11.speaker: color
color.banter.11.stt_text: Not over the engines. You feel it through the floor, though
color.banter.11.text: Not over the engines. You feel it through the floor, though.

color.banter.12.speaker: color
color.banter.12.stt_text: Every word. You don't want to. A crowd changes sides fast
color.banter.12.text: Every word. You don't want to. A crowd changes sides fast.

color.banter.13.speaker: color
color.banter.13.stt_text: Stop trading one for one. They can't afford it anymore
color.banter.13.text: Stop trading one for one. They can't afford it anymore.

color.banter.14.speaker: color
color.banter.14.stt_text: Pick one target and all shoot it. They're spreading their fire around
color.banter.14.text: Pick one target and all shoot it. They're spreading their fire around.

color.banter.15.speaker: color
color.banter.15.stt_text: Whoever has been waiting the longest, the waiting gets to you
color.banter.15.text: Whoever has been waiting the longest. The waiting gets to you.

color.banter.16.speaker: color
color.banter.16.stt_text: Nobody blinks. Somebody runs out of cover. It's different
color.banter.16.text: Nobody blinks. Somebody runs out of cover. It's different.

color.banter.17.speaker: color
color.banter.17.stt_text: back up twenty meters and let them come to me
color.banter.17.text: Back up twenty meters and let them come to me.

color.banter.18.speaker: color
color.banter.18.stt_text: I wouldn't be down there. I did my time. I'm happy up here with you
color.banter.18.text: I wouldn't be down there. I did my time. I'm happy up here with you.

color.banter.19.speaker: color
color.banter.19.stt_text: Only if your own people know where it's landing
color.banter.19.text: Only if your own people know where it's landing.

color.banter.20.speaker: color
color.banter.20.stt_text: It's smart until the fighting gets close, then it's a coin toss
color.banter.20.text: It's smart until the fighting gets close. Then it's a coin toss.

color.banter.21.speaker: color
color.banter.21.stt_text: Not yet. I've come back from worse, not much worse
color.banter.21.text: Not yet. I've come back from worse. Not much worse.

color.banter.22@condemned.speaker: color
color.banter.22@condemned.stt_text: Close to it, but one mistake from The Condemned and it's a match again
color.banter.22@condemned.text: Close to it. But one mistake from the Condemned and it's a match again.

color.banter.22@gangs.speaker: color
color.banter.22@gangs.stt_text: Close to it, but one mistake from the Wreckers and it's a match again
color.banter.22@gangs.text: Close to it. But one mistake from the Wreckers and it's a match again.

color.banter.22@law.speaker: color
color.banter.22@law.stt_text: Close to it, but one mistake from the law and it's a match again
color.banter.22@law.text: Close to it. But one mistake from the Law and it's a match again.

color.banter.22@syndicate.speaker: color
color.banter.22@syndicate.stt_text: Close to it, but one mistake from the Syndicate and it's a match again
color.banter.22@syndicate.text: Close to it. But one mistake from the Syndicate and it's a match again.

color.banter.23.speaker: color
color.banter.23.stt_text: Every match, the day you're not scared is the day they tow you out
color.banter.23.text: Every match. The day you're not scared is the day they tow you out.

color.banter.24.speaker: color
color.banter.24.stt_text: Not during, before and after. During there isn't time
color.banter.24.text: Not during. Before, and after. During, there isn't time.

color.banter.25.speaker: color
color.banter.25.stt_text: Hard to say. Ask me again in a minute
color.banter.25.text: Hard to say. Ask me again in a minute.

color.banter.26.speaker: color
color.banter.26.stt_text: Every second of it. I couldn't tell you what I had for breakfast, but I remember that
color.banter.26.text: Every second of it. I couldn't tell you what I had for breakfast, but I remember that.

color.banter.27.speaker: color
color.banter.27.stt_text: Not really. I remember the tunnel, and then I remember the medics. The middle is gone
color.banter.27.text: Not really. I remember the tunnel, and then I remember the medics. The middle is gone.

color.banter.28.speaker: color
color.banter.28.stt_text: A woman called Harrow. Never raised her voice, never missed. I still check my mirrors for her
color.banter.28.text: A woman called Harrow. Never raised her voice, never missed. I still check my mirrors for her.

color.banter.29.speaker: color
color.banter.29.stt_text: There isn't one. The toughest one is whoever you forgot about
color.banter.29.text: There isn't one. The toughest one is whoever you forgot about.

color.banter.30.speaker: color
color.banter.30.stt_text: Write letters, mostly. The office posts them afterwards, depending
color.banter.30.text: Write letters, mostly. The office posts them afterwards, depending.

color.banter.31.speaker: color
color.banter.31.stt_text: Nothing. They sleep. You'd be surprised how well you sleep when it's out of your hands
color.banter.31.text: Nothing. They sleep. You'd be surprised how well you sleep when it's out of your hands.

color.banter.32.speaker: color
color.banter.32.stt_text: More than the crew inside it. The machine always outlasts the crew
color.banter.32.text: More than the crew inside it. The machine always outlasts the crew.

color.banter.33.speaker: color
color.banter.33.stt_text: Less than you'd think. They're buses with plate on. They were never built for this
color.banter.33.text: Less than you'd think. They're buses with plate on. They were never built for this.

color.close.01.speaker: color
color.close.01.stt_text: Haul like that, every bump hurts. They need to get behind something now
color.close.01.text: Hull like that, every bump hurts. They need to get behind something. Now.

color.close.02.speaker: color
color.close.02.stt_text: I drove a whole match like that once. After a while, you stop looking at the gauges
color.close.02.text: I drove a whole match like that once. After a while you stop looking at the gauges.

color.close.03.speaker: color
color.close.03.stt_text: That crew is praying right now. Maybe it's working
color.close.03.text: That crew is praying right now. Maybe it's working.

color.close.04.speaker: color
color.close.04.stt_text: He's running on luck now. Luck is a terrible plan and a fine backup
color.close.04.text: He's running on luck now. Luck is a terrible plan and a fine backup.

color.close.05.speaker: color
color.close.05.stt_text: Get out of there right now. Whatever you're doing, stop doing it
color.close.05.text: Get out of there. Right now. Whatever you're doing, stop doing it.

color.close.06.speaker: color
color.close.06.stt_text: That machine is held together by the paint
color.close.06.text: That machine is held together by the paint.

color.close.07.speaker: color
color.close.07.stt_text: That was about a hand's width from being over
color.close.07.text: That was about a hand's width from being over.

color.close.08.speaker: color
color.close.08.stt_text: A hit like that makes you a careful driver for the rest of your life
color.close.08.text: A hit like that makes you a careful driver for the rest of your life.

color.contact.01.speaker: color
color.contact.01.stt_text: First shot isn't the fight, first hit is
color.contact.01.text: First shot isn't the fight. First hit is.

color.contact.02.speaker: color
color.contact.02.stt_text: Whoever shot first just told everybody where they are. Now we see if it was worth it
color.contact.02.text: Whoever shot first just told everybody where they are. Now we see if it was worth it.

color.contact.03.speaker: color
color.contact.03.stt_text: Now everybody knows where everybody is. This is where it gets honest
color.contact.03.text: Now everybody knows where everybody is. This is where it gets honest.

color.contact.04.speaker: color
color.contact.04.stt_text: They're shooting a little early for my liking. That's nerves
color.contact.04.text: They're shooting a little early for my liking. That's nerves.

color.contact.05.speaker: color
color.contact.05.stt_text: That scout did its job. Now it needs to get out of there
color.contact.05.text: That scout did its job. Now it needs to get out of there.

color.contact.06.speaker: color
color.contact.06.stt_text: Now it starts. Everything before this was driving
color.contact.06.text: Now it starts. Everything before this was driving.

color.contact.07.speaker: color
color.contact.07.stt_text: First shot's a question. The answer comes back in about two seconds
color.contact.07.text: First shot's a question. The answer comes back in about two seconds.

color.contact.08.speaker: color
color.contact.08.stt_text: Both sides know where the other is now. Nobody gets to be clever anymore
color.contact.08.text: Both sides know where the other is now. Nobody gets to be clever anymore.

color.contact.09.speaker: color
color.contact.09.stt_text: Good. Early contact is better than late. Late contact means somebody was lost
color.contact.09.text: Good. Early contact is better than late. Late contact means somebody was lost.

color.contact.10.speaker: color
color.contact.10.stt_text: You'll see them spread out now. If they don't, that's a problem
color.contact.10.text: You'll see them spread out now. If they don't, that's a problem.

color.contact.11.speaker: color
color.contact.11.stt_text: The first few seconds of contact decide more than people think
color.contact.11.text: The first few seconds of contact decide more than people think.

color.contact.12.speaker: color
color.contact.12.stt_text: That was a long shot. Long shots are information more than damage
color.contact.12.text: That was a long shot. Long shots are information more than damage.

color.contact.13.speaker: color
color.contact.13.stt_text: Everybody's heart rate just doubled. Mine too, and I'm up here
color.contact.13.text: Everybody's heart rate just doubled. Mine too, and I'm up here.

color.contact.14.speaker: color
color.contact.14.stt_text: Now watch who moves and who stops. The ones who stop are the ones who planned
color.contact.14.text: Now watch who moves and who stops. The ones who stop are the ones who planned.

color.contact.15.speaker: color
color.contact.15.stt_text: They found each other in the middle. That's usually a brawl
color.contact.15.text: They found each other in the middle. That's usually a brawl.

color.contact.16.speaker: color
color.contact.16.stt_text: Whoever's leading that element has about three seconds to make a decision
color.contact.16.text: Whoever's leading that element has about three seconds to make a decision.

color.contact.17.speaker: color
color.contact.17.stt_text: Shooting at range in here is mostly noise. The real fight comes when they close
color.contact.17.text: Shooting at range in here is mostly noise. The real fight comes when they close.

color.contact.18.speaker: color

color.drill.25.text: Assault through. You don't stop in the killzone. Not for anything.

color.drill.26.stt_text: Support by fire. Half of them are just there to make the other side keep their heads down
color.drill.26.text: Support by fire. Half of them are just there to make the other side keep their heads down.

color.drill.27.speaker: color
color.drill.27.stt_text: Far ambush. You get out of the line of fire first and think second
color.drill.27.text: Far ambush, you get out of the line of fire first and think second.

color.drill.28.speaker: color
color.drill.28.stt_text: That's bait. Somebody is being offered up so somebody else can get a clean shot
color.drill.28.text: That's bait. Somebody is being offered up so somebody else can get a clean shot.

color.drill.ambush.01.speaker: color
color.drill.ambush.01.stt_text: Near ambush. They turn into it and drive at it. Six seconds and it's decided one way or the other
color.drill.ambush.01.text: Near ambush. They turn into it and drive at it. Six seconds and it's decided, one way or the other.

color.drill.ambush.02.speaker: color
color.drill.ambush.02.stt_text: That's the drill nobody wants. You're already inside the kill zone, so the only way out is through whoever put you there
color.drill.ambush.02.text: That's the drill nobody wants. You're already inside the killzone, so the only way out is through whoever put you there.

color.faction.01.speaker: color
color.faction.01.stt_text: Those are my people. Every one of those crews is driving for a shorter sentence
color.faction.01.text: Those are my people. Every one of those crews is driving for a shorter sentence.

color.faction.02.speaker: color
color.faction.02.stt_text: Gangs don't carry shields, they carry spare parts. You have to respect that
color.faction.02.text: Gangs don't carry shields. They carry spare parts. You have to respect that.

color.faction.03.speaker: color
color.faction.03.stt_text: The law looks good on paper. Then you look at the rust around the bolts
color.faction.03.text: The Law looks good on paper. Then you look at the rust around the bolts.

color.faction.04.speaker: color
color.faction.04.stt_text: Nobody is inside those. Remember that when they start winning
color.faction.04.text: Nobody is inside those. Remember that when they start winning.

color.faction.05.speaker: color
color.faction.05.stt_text: They'll build another one. They always build another one
color.faction.05.text: They'll build another one. They always build another one.

color.faction.06.speaker: color
color.faction.06.stt_text: No shields, so they don't wait. Get in close and hit first. It's the only way they know
color.faction.06.text: No shields, so they don't wait. Get in close and hit first. It's the only way they know.

color.faction.07.speaker: color
color.faction.07.stt_text: The condemned drive what they're given. You learn to love what you're given
color.faction.07.text: The Condemned drive what they're given. You learn to love what you're given.

color.faction.08.speaker: color
color.faction.08.stt_text: Most of those condemned crews learned to drive in the yard. There's a track. I drove it
color.faction.08.text: Most of those Condemned crews learned to drive in the yard. There's a track. I drove it.

color.faction.09.speaker: color
color.faction.09.stt_text: The Wreckers build their own. Every one of those machines is different under the paint
color.faction.09.text: The Wreckers build their own. Every one of those machines is different under the paint.

color.faction.10.speaker: color
color.faction.10.stt_text: Road crews fight like they're paid by the minute. Fast, loud, early
color.faction.10.text: Road crews fight like they're paid by the minute. Fast, loud, early.

color.faction.11.speaker: color
color.faction.11.stt_text: The law drills well. Their problem has always been what to do once the drill is done.
color.faction.11.text: The Law drills well. Their problem has always been what to do once the drill is done.

color.faction.12.speaker: color
color.faction.12.stt_text: Law crews are the only ones in here who get paid either way
color.faction.12.text: Law crews are the only ones in here who get paid either way.

color.faction.13.speaker: color
color.faction.13.stt_text: Syndicate machines don't get tired. That's worth more than armor in a long match
color.faction.13.text: Syndicate machines don't get tired. That's worth more than armor in a long match.

color.faction.14.speaker: color
color.faction.14.stt_text: They send the new syndicate models here first. It's cheaper than a test track
color.faction.14.text: They send the new Syndicate models here first. It's cheaper than a test track.

color.ff.02.speaker: color
color.ff.02.stt_text: The shell doesn't know what color you are
color.ff.02.text: The shell doesn't know what color you are.

color.ff.03.speaker: color
color.ff.03.stt_text: You bring artillery, you put it behind your people, not on top of them
color.ff.03.text: You bring artillery, you put it behind your people. Not on top of them.

color.ff.04@artillery.speaker: color
color.ff.04@artillery.stt_text: They'll say the artillery drifted into the line. It didn't
color.ff.04@artillery.text: They'll say the artillery drifted into the line. It didn't.

color.ff.04@burner.speaker: color
color.ff.04@burner.stt_text: They'll say the burner drifted into the line. It didn't
color.ff.04@burner.text: They'll say the Burner drifted into the line. It didn't.

color.ff.04@ifv.speaker: color
color.ff.04@ifv.stt_text: They'll say the IFV drifted into the line. It didn't
color.ff.04@ifv.text: They'll say the IFV drifted into the line. It didn't.

color.ff.04@lancer.speaker: color
color.ff.04@lancer.stt_text: They'll say the lancer drifted into the line. It didn't
color.ff.04@lancer.text: They'll say the Lancer drifted into the line. It didn't.

color.ff.04@scout.speaker: color
color.ff.04@scout.stt_text: They'll say the scout drifted into the line. It didn't
color.ff.04@scout.text: They'll say the scout drifted into the line. It didn't.

color.ff.04@tank.speaker: color
color.ff.04@tank.stt_text: They'll say the tank drifted into the line. It didn't
color.ff.04@tank.text: They'll say the tank drifted into the line. It didn't.

color.ff.05.speaker: color
color.ff.05.stt_text: I mentioned this before the match. Nobody listens to me
color.ff.05.text: I mentioned this before the match. Nobody listens to me.

color.ff.06@condemned.speaker: color
color.ff.06@condemned.stt_text: That's not the first time tonight. The condemned need to fix it now
color.ff.06@condemned.text: That's not the first time tonight. The Condemned need to fix it now.

color.ff.06@gangs.speaker: color
color.ff.06@gangs.stt_text: That's not the first time tonight. The wreckers need to fix it now
color.ff.06@gangs.text: That's not the first time tonight. The Wreckers need to fix it now.

color.ff.06@law.speaker: color
color.ff.06@law.stt_text: That's not the first time tonight. The law need to fix it now
color.ff.06@law.text: That's not the first time tonight. The Law need to fix it now.

color.ff.06@syndicate.speaker: color
color.ff.06@syndicate.stt_text: That's not the first time tonight. The Syndicate need to fix it now
color.ff.06@syndicate.text: That's not the first time tonight. The Syndicate need to fix it now.

color.ff.07.speaker: color
color.ff.07.stt_text: He fired at movement instead of a target. In here, everything moves
color.ff.07.text: He fired at movement instead of a target. In here, everything moves.

color.ff.08.speaker: color
color.ff.08.stt_text: Somebody is going to have a very quiet ride home
color.ff.08.text: Somebody is going to have a very quiet ride home.

color.ff.09.speaker: color
color.ff.09.stt_text: Check your lanes. First thing they teach you, last thing anybody remembers
color.ff.09.text: Check your lanes. First thing they teach you. Last thing anybody remembers.

color.ff.10.speaker: color
color.ff.10.stt_text: He saw a shape and fired. The shape was a friend
color.ff.10.text: He saw a shape and fired. The shape was a friend.

color.ff.11.speaker: color
color.ff.11.stt_text: Crossfire is a plan until you're standing in the middle of it
color.ff.11.text: Crossfire is a plan until you're standing in the middle of it.

color.ff.12.speaker: color
color.ff.12.stt_text: You don't aim at a spot in here, you aim at a thing. He aimed at a spot
color.ff.12.text: You don't aim at a spot in here. You aim at a thing. He aimed at a spot.

color.ff.13.speaker: color
color.ff.13.stt_text: That's a conversation for after the match. A long one
color.ff.13.text: That's a conversation for after the match. A long one.

color.ff.14.speaker: color
color.ff.14.stt_text: With too many guns pointed at too small a space, somebody was always going to get hit
color.ff.14.text: Too many guns pointed at too small a space. Somebody was always going to get hit.

color.flat.01.speaker: color
color.flat.01.stt_text: When you're driving in that formation, the point man had better be ready for whatever comes next. There's about a ninety percent chance his life is about to end
color.flat.01.text: When you're driving in that formation, the point man had better be ready for whatever comes next. There's about a ninety percent chance his life is about to end.

color.flat.02.speaker: color
color.flat.02.stt_text: The crew that fires first usually lives. That's not a saying. Somebody counted
color.flat.02.text: The crew that fires first usually lives. That's not a saying. Somebody counted.

color.flat.03.speaker: color
color.flat.03.stt_text: Nobody gets out of one of those once it goes up. They don't design the hatch for that
color.flat.03.text: Nobody gets out of one of those once it goes up. They don't design the hatch for that.

color.flat.04.speaker: color
color.flat.04.stt_text: The floor gets cleared between sessions. It takes about 11 minutes
color.flat.04.text: The floor gets cleared between sessions. It takes about eleven minutes.

color.flat.05.speaker: color
color.flat.05.stt_text: He'll feel that for the rest of his life, which in his case is being decided right now
color.flat.05.text: He'll feel that for the rest of his life. Which, in his case, is being decided right now.

color.flat.06.speaker: color
color.flat.06.stt_text: Most of these crews signed up. Not all of them. The paperwork looks identical either way
color.flat.06.text: Most of these crews signed up. Not all of them. The paperwork looks identical either way.

color.flat.07.speaker: color
color.flat.07.stt_text: That happens more than you'd think. The Syndicate counts it the same as any other loss, so there's no reason for anyone to be careful about it
color.flat.07.text: That happens more than you'd think. The Syndicate counts it the same as any other loss, so there's no reason for anyone to be careful about it.

color.flat.08.speaker: color
color.flat.08.stt_text: A hit like that doesn't kill the driver. The next one does. He knows that better than we do
color.flat.08.text: A hit like that doesn't kill the driver. The next one does. He knows that better than we do.

color.flat.09.speaker: color
color.flat.09.stt_text: The winners get their sentence reduced. The reduction is calculated after the medical review, so it varies
color.flat.09.text: The winners get their sentence reduced. The reduction is calculated after the medical review, so it varies.

color.flat.10.speaker: color
color.flat.10.stt_text: You hear that ringing? Everybody inside those hulls will have that for a few years, then it stops
color.flat.10.text: You hear that ringing? Everybody inside those hulls will have that for a few years. Then it stops.

color.flat.11.speaker: color
color.flat.11.stt_text: Once a crew starts losing in here, it goes fast. It's better that way, I'm told
color.flat.11.text: Once a crew starts losing in here, it goes fast. It's better that way, I'm told.

color.flat.12.speaker: color
color.flat.12.stt_text: The pits were an idea somebody had in an office. Everyone agreed it tested well
color.flat.12.text: The pits were an idea somebody had in an office. Everyone agreed it tested well.

color.kill.14.stt_text: That's what happens when nobody checks behind them. It's a big floor

color.kill.15@syndicate.text: The Syndicate didn't panic. That's the whole comeback right there. Nobody panicked.

color.kill.16@condemned.stt_text: The condemned keep feeding them one at a time. Regroup. Please regroup
color.kill.16@condemned.text: The Condemned keep feeding them one at a time. Regroup. Please regroup.

color.kill.16@syndicate.text: The Syndicate keep feeding them one at a time. Regroup. Please regroup.

color.kill.17@condemned.speaker: color
color.kill.17@condemned.stt_text: There go the eyes. I said it before the match. Watch what happens to the condemned now
color.kill.17@condemned.text: There go the eyes. I said it before the match. Watch what happens to the Condemned now.

color.kill.17@gangs.speaker: color
color.kill.17@gangs.stt_text: There go the eyes. I said it before the match. Watch what happens to the Wreckers now
color.kill.17@gangs.text: There go the eyes. I said it before the match. Watch what happens to the Wreckers now.

color.kill.17@law.speaker: color
color.kill.17@law.stt_text: There go the eyes. I said it before the match. Watch what happens to the law now
color.kill.17@law.text: There go the eyes. I said it before the match. Watch what happens to the Law now.

color.kill.17@syndicate.speaker: color
color.kill.17@syndicate.stt_text: There go the eyes. I said it before the match. Watch what happens to the Syndicate now
color.kill.17@syndicate.text: There go the eyes. I said it before the match. Watch what happens to the Syndicate now.

color.kill.18.speaker: color
color.kill.18.stt_text: Artillery with nobody guarding it, that's a gift
color.kill.18.text: Artillery with nobody guarding it. That's a gift.

color.kill.19.speaker: color
color.kill.19.stt_text: The turret can't turn that fast. The scout knew it. That's a smart driver
color.kill.19.text: The turret can't turn that fast. The scout knew it. That's a smart driver.

color.kill.20.speaker: color
color.kill.20.stt_text: Even trades favor whoever has more left. Count them before you swing
color.kill.20.text: Even trades favor whoever has more left. Count them before you swing.

color.kill.21.speaker: color
color.kill.21.stt_text: That's a brawl. Nobody planned that. Somebody's going to wish they had
color.kill.21.text: That's a brawl. Nobody planned that. Somebody's going to wish they had.

color.kill.22.speaker: color
color.kill.22.stt_text: He saw it too late. In here, too late is about half a second
color.kill.22.text: He saw it too late. In here, too late is about half a second.

color.kill.23.speaker: color
color.kill.23.stt_text: He stopped to aim. You can't stop to aim in here
color.kill.23.text: He stopped to aim. You can't stop to aim in here.

color.kill.24.speaker: color
color.kill.24.stt_text: That's what focus fire looks like. Two guns, one target, done
color.kill.24.text: That's what focus fire looks like. Two guns, one target, done.

color.kill.25.speaker: color
color.kill.25.stt_text: The crew is out of that one. The machine will be back next session. They always are
color.kill.25.text: The crew is out of that one. The machine will be back next session. They always are.

color.kill.26.speaker: color
color.kill.26.stt_text: Wrong place, wrong angle, wrong second. Get one of those right and you live. Not all three wrong
color.kill.26.text: Wrong place, wrong angle, wrong second. Get one of those right and you live. Not all three wrong.

color.kill.27.speaker: color
color.kill.27.stt_text: Nothing fancy there, just a better position
color.kill.27.text: Nothing fancy there. Just a better position.

color.kill.28.speaker: color
color.kill.28.stt_text: That's the one they'll talk about in the debrief. Not the kill, the ten seconds before it
color.kill.28.text: That's the one they'll talk about in the debrief. Not the kill. The ten seconds before it.

color.kill.29.speaker: color
color.kill.29.stt_text: He had a way out. He didn't take it. I don't know why
color.kill.29.text: He had a way out. He didn't take it. I don't know why.

color.kill.30.speaker: color
color.kill.30.stt_text: You lose one, you tighten up. Watch whether they tighten up
color.kill.30.text: You lose one, you tighten up. Watch whether they tighten up.

color.kill.31.speaker: color
color.kill.31.stt_text: That kill was set up by somebody we didn't even see. That's teamwork
color.kill.31.text: That kill was set up by somebody we didn't even see. That's teamwork.

color.kill.32.speaker: color
color.kill.32.stt_text: Sat in the open for three full seconds. That's a long time in here
color.kill.32.text: Sat in the open for three full seconds. That's a long time in here.

color.kill.33.speaker: color
color.kill.33.stt_text: Every kill changes the floor. Now there's a gap on that side, and everybody knows it
color.kill.33.text: Every kill changes the floor. Now there's a gap on that side, and everybody knows it.

color.kill.34.speaker: color
color.kill.34.stt_text: He took his shot and then he took another. Most people stopped to see if the first one worked
color.kill.34.text: He took his shot and then he took another. Most people stop to see if the first one worked.

color.kill.35.speaker: color
color.kill.35.stt_text: That's the problem with chasing. Eventually you catch up to something
color.kill.35.text: That's the problem with chasing. Eventually you catch up to something.

color.kill.36.speaker: color
color.kill.36.stt_text: Big tank, big target. They put a lot of steel on it and forgot the sides
color.kill.36.text: Big tank, big target. They put a lot of steel on it and forgot the sides.

color.kill.37.speaker: color
color.kill.37.stt_text: Scouts die. That's the job. The good ones die later
color.kill.37.text: Scouts die. That's the job. The good ones die later.

color.kill.38.speaker: color
color.kill.38.stt_text: Artillery kill. The crew never saw who did it. That's the worst way, I think
color.kill.38.text: Artillery kill. The crew never saw who did it. That's the worst way, I think.

color.kill.39.speaker: color
color.kill.39.stt_text: And there go the eyes, like I said, driving blind from here
color.kill.39.text: And there go the eyes, like I said. Driving blind from here.

color.kill.40.speaker: color
color.kill.40.stt_text: Somebody got to the artillery. I did say somebody usually does
color.kill.40.text: Somebody got to the artillery. I did say somebody usually does.

color.kill.41.speaker: color
color.kill.41.stt_text: That's the flank I was talking about. Nobody was watching it then either
color.kill.41.text: That's the flank I was talking about. Nobody was watching it then either.

color.lore.01.speaker: color
color.lore.01.stt_text: They let me keep my number when I got out. I still turn around when somebody says it
color.lore.01.text: They let me keep my number when I got out. I still turn around when somebody says it.

color.lore.02.speaker: color
color.lore.02.stt_text: The paperwork says every one of those crews volunteered. I signed the same paperwork
color.lore.02.text: The paperwork says every one of those crews volunteered. I signed the same paperwork.

color.lore.03.speaker: color
color.lore.03.stt_text: My first season in here, they didn't have the lights yet. You fought by the muzzle flashes
color.lore.03.text: My first season in here, they didn't have the lights yet. You fought by the muzzle flashes.

color.lore.04.speaker: color
color.lore.04.stt_text: I drove a bus a lot like those before the plating. It had a route, school route
color.lore.04.text: I drove a bus a lot like those, before the plating. It had a route. School route.

color.lore.05.speaker: color
color.lore.05.stt_text: People ask if I miss it. I don't. I still dream about the floor, though
color.lore.05.text: People ask if I miss it. I don't. I still dream about the floor, though.

color.lore.06.speaker: color
color.lore.06.stt_text: Best driver I ever saw in here never fired first. Not once. Nine seasons
color.lore.06.text: Best driver I ever saw in here never fired first. Not once. Nine seasons.

color.lore.07.speaker: color
color.lore.07.stt_text: The crews talk before the match, not about the match, about food mostly
color.lore.07.text: The crews talk before the match. Not about the match. About food, mostly.

color.lore.08.speaker: color
color.lore.08.stt_text: You learn the floor by the scorch marks. Every one of them is somebody's bad night
color.lore.08.text: You learn the floor by the scorch marks. Every one of them is somebody's bad night.

color.lore.09.speaker: color
color.lore.09.stt_text: They repaint the walls every season. It never quite covers everything
color.lore.09.text: They repaint the walls every season. It never quite covers everything.

color.lore.10.speaker: color
color.lore.10.stt_text: First thing they teach you is how to reverse. The ones who skip that lesson aren't around to teach it
color.lore.10.text: First thing they teach you is how to reverse. The ones who skipped that lesson aren't around to teach it.

color.lore.11@boneyard.stt_text: My last match was in the Boneyard. Same lights. I didn't look up once
color.lore.11@boneyard.text: My last match was in the Boneyard. Same lights. I didn't look up once.

color.lore.11@crossing.speaker: color

color.lore.11@crossing.text: My last match was in the Crossing. Same lights. I didn't look up once.

color.lore.11@pit.text: My last match was in the Pit. Same lights. I didn't look up once.

color.lore.11@scrapyard.text: My last match was in the Scrapyard. Same lights. I didn't look up once.

color.lore.11@sumps.speaker: color

color.lore.11@sumps.text: My last match was in the Sumps. Same lights. I didn't look up once.

color.lore.11@terminus.speaker: color
color.lore.11@terminus.stt_text: My last match was in the Terminus. Same lights. I didn't look up once
color.lore.11@terminus.text: My last match was in the Terminus. Same lights. I didn't look up once.

color.lore.11@yard.stt_text: My last match was in the container yard, same lights. I didn't look up once
color.lore.11@yard.text: My last match was in the Container Yard. Same lights. I didn't look up once.

color.lore.12.speaker: color
color.lore.12.stt_text: The medics in my day had one stretcher. They were very quick with it
color.lore.12.text: The medics in my day had one stretcher. They were very quick with it.

color.lore.13.speaker: color
color.lore.13.stt_text: I kept a photograph taped to the dash. Everybody did. They cleaned them out between seasons
color.lore.13.text: I kept a photograph taped to the dash. Everybody did. They clean them out between seasons.

color.lore.14.speaker: color
color.lore.14.stt_text: The loudest thing in a match isn't the guns, it's your engine when you're trying to hear something else
color.lore.14.text: The loudest thing in a match isn't the guns. It's your engine, when you're trying to hear something else.

color.lore.15.speaker: color
color.lore.15.stt_text: They gave me a watch when I got out. It stopped the next year. I kept it anyway
color.lore.15.text: They gave me a watch when I got out. It stopped the next year. I kept it anyway.

color.lore.16.speaker: color
color.lore.16.stt_text: My first season, the crowd threw things. The second season, they put up the nets. Nobody asked why
color.lore.16.text: My first season, the crowd threw things. The second season, they put up the nets. Nobody asked why.

color.lore.17.speaker: color
color.lore.17.stt_text: There was an old mechanic who'd listen to your engine and tell you how long you had. He was usually right
color.lore.17.text: There was an old mechanic who'd listen to your engine and tell you how long you had. He was usually right.

color.lore.18.speaker: color
color.lore.18.stt_text: People think you're scared of the other crews, you're scared of the floor. So are they
color.lore.18.text: People think you're scared of the other crews. You're scared of the floor. So are they.

color.lore.19.speaker: color
color.lore.19.stt_text: We used to paint our own numbers on. Now they come printed. It's more efficient
color.lore.19.text: We used to paint our own numbers on. Now they come printed. It's more efficient.

color.lore.20.speaker: color
color.lore.20.stt_text: I still wake up at the time the matches used to start. My body never got the message
color.lore.20.text: I still wake up at the time the matches used to start. My body never got the message.

color.lore.21.speaker: color
color.lore.21.stt_text: My loader was a quiet kid, good hands. I think about him most nights before the broadcast
color.lore.21.text: My loader was a quiet kid. Good hands. I think about him most nights before the broadcast.

color.lull.01.speaker: color
color.lull.01.stt_text: Even match. Even matches get decided by whoever gets impatient first
color.lull.01.text: Even match. Even matches get decided by whoever gets impatient first.

color.lull.02.speaker: color
color.lull.02.stt_text: The side that's ahead can wait. The side that's behind can't. That's the whole shape of it now
color.lull.02.text: The side that's ahead can wait. The side that's behind can't. That's the whole shape of it now.

color.lull.03.speaker: color
color.lull.03.stt_text: Quiet like this, the crews are reloading, repairing, and counting. Mostly counting
color.lull.03.text: Quiet like this, the crews are reloading, repairing, and counting. Mostly counting.

color.lull.04.speaker: color
color.lull.04.stt_text: If the crowd settles, you can hear the engines idling. That's a dozen people thinking very hard
color.lull.04.text: If the crowd settles, you can hear the engines idling. That's a dozen people thinking very hard.

color.teach.arty01.speaker: color
color.teach.arty01.stt_text: Artillery doesn't kill you. It moves you somewhere that does
color.teach.arty01.text: Artillery doesn't kill you. It moves you somewhere that does.

color.teach.bunching.01.speaker: color
color.teach.bunching.01.stt_text: Bunched up like that, only the front two can shoot. Seven seconds before that pack hurt anybody
color.teach.bunching.01.text: Bunched up like that, only the front two can shoot. Seven seconds before that pack hurt anybody.

color.teach.circling.01.speaker: color
color.teach.circling.01.stt_text: Circling looks aggressive. It deals about a third of the damage because nobody driving a circle is aiming
color.teach.circling.01.text: Circling looks aggressive. It deals about a third of the damage, because nobody driving a circle is aiming.

color.teach.cover01.speaker: color
color.teach.cover01.stt_text: You don't sit in cover. You shoot from behind it and you move. Sitting is how cover kills you
color.teach.cover01.text: You don't sit in cover. You shoot from behind it and you move. Sitting is how cover kills you.

color.teach.cover02.speaker: color
color.teach.cover02.stt_text: Hard cover stops a shell. Soft cover just stops them seeing you. Knowing which is which is most of it
color.teach.cover02.text: Hard cover stops a shell. Soft cover just stops them seeing you. Knowing which is which is most of it.

color.teach.flank01.speaker: color
color.teach.flank01.stt_text: That's why you go around. Front armor is thick everywhere and thin nowhere else
color.teach.flank01.text: That's why you go around. Front armor is thick everywhere and thin nowhere else.

color.teach.flank02.speaker: color
color.teach.flank02.stt_text: Turrets turn slower than vehicles do. That's the whole trick. That's it. That's the trick
color.teach.flank02.text: Turrets turn slower than vehicles do. That's the whole trick. That's it, that's the trick.

color.teach.focus01.speaker: color
color.teach.focus01.stt_text: Two guns on one target beats one gun on two targets. It sounds obvious. Watch how few crews do it
color.teach.focus01.text: Two guns on one target beats one gun on two targets. It sounds obvious. Watch how few crews do it.

color.teach.halt01.speaker: color
color.teach.halt01.stt_text: When they stop, watch which way the guns point. A crew that knows what it's doing covers every direction without being told
color.teach.halt01.text: When they stop, watch which way the guns point. A crew that knows what it's doing covers every direction without being told.

color.teach.mg01.speaker: color
color.teach.mg01.stt_text: A machine gun won't open armor. It'll keep a crew's heads down while something else does
color.teach.mg01.text: A machine gun won't open armor. It'll keep a crew's heads down while something else does.

color.teach.open01.speaker: color
color.teach.open01.stt_text: Open ground. In here, open ground is just a place you haven't been shot yet
color.teach.open01.text: Open ground. In here, open ground is just a place you haven't been shot yet.

color.teach.retreat01.speaker: color
color.teach.retreat01.stt_text: Backing out under fire is the hardest thing there is. Most crews learn it once
color.teach.retreat01.text: Backing out under fire is the hardest thing there is. Most crews learn it once.

color.teach.screen01.speaker: color
color.teach.screen01.stt_text: You put the heavy where the shooting is and the fragile one behind it. Nobody wants that job. Somebody has it
color.teach.screen01.text: You put the heavy where the shooting is and the fragile one behind it. Nobody wants that job. Somebody has it.

color.teach.spacing01.speaker: color
color.teach.spacing01.stt_text: Spacing is the whole game. Too close and one shell takes two of you. Too far and nobody can help anybody
color.teach.spacing01.text: Spacing is the whole game. Too close and one shell takes two of you. Too far and nobody can help anybody.

color.teach.spacing02.speaker: color
color.teach.spacing02.stt_text: Watch the gaps between them. That's where the next one dies
color.teach.spacing02.text: Watch the gaps between them. That's where the next one dies.

color.teach.speed01.speaker: color
color.teach.speed01.stt_text: Fast doesn't mean safe. Fast means you arrive at the problem sooner
color.teach.speed01.text: Fast doesn't mean safe. Fast means you arrive at the problem sooner.

color.teach.weakspot01.speaker: color
color.teach.weakspot01.stt_text: Every one of those machines has a place where the plate is thin, usually where somebody had to reach in and fix something
color.teach.weakspot01.text: Every one of those machines has a place where the plate is thin. Usually where somebody had to reach in and fix something.

color.technique.bound.01.speaker: color
color.technique.bound.01.stt_text: Bounding. Half of them move, half of them watch, and then they swap. Nobody is ever all moving at once
color.technique.bound.01.text: Bounding. Half of them move, half of them watch, and then they swap. Nobody is ever all moving at once.

color.technique.bound.02.speaker: color
color.technique.bound.02.stt_text: Watch the back half there. They don't roll until the front half is set. That's the whole idea
color.technique.bound.02.text: Watch the back half there. They don't roll until the front half is set. That's the whole idea.

color.technique.over.01.speaker: color

color.technique.over.01.text: Traveling overwatch. Moving, but with somebody always looking the wrong way on purpose.

color.technique.trav.01.speaker: color
color.technique.trav.01.stt_text: Just traveling. No overwatch, no bounding. They're getting somewhere and hoping
color.technique.trav.01.text: Just traveling. No overwatch, no bounding. They're getting somewhere and hoping.

color.trail.01.speaker: color

color.trail.01.text: You want your heavy on the outside of the turn, because if he's on the inside then the whole... yeah. It's a thing you learn.

color.trail.02.speaker: color

color.trail.02.text: Now, the correct answer here is to break contact and reset, unless the ground is... hm. Depends on the ground.

color.trail.03.text: See, that's what happens when you lead with the wrong... well. You saw it.

color.trail.04.speaker: color

color.trail.04.text: There's a reason you angle the hull, and it's to do with the plate thickness against the... anyway. Angle the hull.

color.trail.05.text: We used to have a whole system for this. Hand signals, the works. Couldn't tell you a single one of them now.

color.trail.07.text: This is the part where you either commit or you don't, and the crews that get it wrong are usually the ones that... sorry, what was the question?

color.trail.08.text: First one's always the same. Somebody forgets something simple. I forgot something simple for nine seasons.

color.trail.10.speaker: color
color.trail.10.stt_text: Now, if he'd taken that hit three feet further left, the whole... No, actually three feet left is worse. Forget that
color.trail.10.text: Now if he'd taken that hit three feet further left, the whole... no, actually, three feet left is worse. Forget that.

color.trail.12.speaker: color
